scope_groups.header: Synthetic Turf Sports Field - Provide all materials, labor, equipment, and supervision for a complete Scope of Work per plans and specifications. This Scope of Work shall include, but not be limited to:
items: Supply and install a complete NFHS-compliant synthetic turf system, including base, geotextile, shock pad, header boards, turf, and infill.
Basis of design is Hellas Matrix Helix 46 oz. turf, Elia Renufill/Realfill infill, and Soteria 20mm shock pad.
Includes fine grading of the aggregate base to manufacturer tolerance for turf installation.
Supply and install approximately 1,134 linear feet of nailer board on concrete curb supplied by others.
Includes turf colors as indicated (RS-101, RS-102, RS-103).
Includes football and soccer game striping, lettering, and center field logo, as indicated.
Perform percolation testing prior to installation.
Provide HIC and G-Max testing upon completion, including additional mobilizations as required.
Coordinate with Landscaping, Running Track Surfacing, Concrete, and Wet Utilities Subcontractors as required.
Provide dust control per Nye County Air Quality requirements for this Scope of Work.
Clean and maintain trucking access routes, including street sweeping, for this Scope of Work only.
Legally dispose of all soil spoils and debris generated by this Scope of Work; no stockpiling permitted.

exclusions: Concrete curb and track perimeter drainage
Athletic field equipment and event surfacing
Field drainage system inside turf perimeter

_open_pm_items.title: Sprinturf, LLC bid this package but appears on no tab row for it
_open_pm_items.detail: Carried forward from the package index. Sprinturf's price is tabulated under RFP-016 at a combined $1,022,155 for Landscaping, Irrigation and Synthetic Turf; RFP-022's own tab row omits Sprinturf entirely.

_open_pm_items.title: Tand Inc. bid RFP-016 and RFP-022 as one bundled scope
_open_pm_items.detail: Carried forward from the package index. Tand's document describes both packages; neither price nor scope splits cleanly without a descope.

_open_pm_items.title: Percolation testing: narrative requires it, awarded sub excludes it
_open_pm_items.detail: Scope of Work #022 states 'Perform all required percolation tests prior to installation.' CG&B's 05.12.26 proposal, under SPECIFIC EXCLUSIONS (not the generic boilerplate list), states '4) Percolation testing is not included.' This is a deliberate, specific exclusion, not boilerplate, and it directly contradicts the narrative. The exhibit carries the narrative's obligation per the document authority hierarchy; confirm scope and price before buyout.

_open_pm_items.title: Mobilizations: CG&B prices one, the narrative and Attachment A both require multiple
_open_pm_items.detail: CG&B's proposal states 'One mobilization/demobilization is included in pricing. Anything past that will be charged at $6,500 per mobilization.' The Scope of Work narrative requires 'multiple mobilizations, import/export, and haul/disposal activities as may be required per the Preliminary Construction Schedule and Logistics Plan,' and the Attachment A's own PROJECT SPECIFIC PROVISIONS (paragraph 94) is drafted 'multiple mobilizations' by standing house format. Given the turf field's sequencing behind paving, track curb and concrete work, more than one mobilization is a real possibility. Confirm before buyout; this is unpriced cost exposure at $6,500 per occurrence.

_open_pm_items.title: Geotextile fabric under the turf field: not itemized in CG&B's price breakdown
_open_pm_items.detail: The narrative lists 'geotextile underlayment' as a required component of the complete turf system, and L1.03 detail D calls for geotextile fabric over the subgrade and through trenches. CG&B's itemized base-scope pricing (4" base rock, 1,134 linear feet of nailer board, Soteria pad, Matrix Helix turf) does not list geotextile fabric as a line item. Separately, TAB's (RFP-008) 05.22.26 re-priced homework response carries a deduct of $150,000 for 'Delete Type II and geofabric from turf field,' which reads as removing that scope from the earthwork package on the assumption the turf package carries it. Confirm the $1,139,000 actually includes geotextile fabric under the full turf footprint before this becomes an uncarried gap between the two packages.

_open_pm_items.title: AstroTurf's 'not lowest bidder' comparison appears to price track surfacing, not turf
_open_pm_items.detail: The package record flags CG&B's $1,139,000 award as not the lowest bid, citing AstroTurf at $609,151. AstroTurf's proposal document filed under this package is titled 'Track Surfacing' and prices approximately 7,335 SY of Rekortan BS track system (the same product named in Section 32 18 23.33's manufacturer list for RFP-021), including an ADD ALTERNATE for 'Turnkey Track Construction and Surfacing' at $1,851,285. A separate section of the same document also describes a 73,800 SF AstroTurf Rhino 46oz turf field with its own drainage and sports-equipment add-ons, but no standalone turf-only total is captured. The $609,151 figure being compared to CG&B's turf award is very likely a track-surfacing price, not a turf price - recommend verifying against whatever price AstroTurf submitted (if any) on the RFP-021 Running Track Surfacing bidder list before treating CG&B as high bidder.

_open_pm_items.title: Nailer board: one non-awarded bidder places it in the Concrete package
_open_pm_items.detail: Sprinturf's 05.15.26 scope-review agenda states 'Concrete package should have the nailer board.' The narrative and CG&B's own base bid both place the 1,134 linear foot perimeter nailer board inside this Scope of Work, and this exhibit follows that. Worth a scope-qa check that RFP-030 (Concrete) does not also carry a nailer-board line item - the same double-claim pattern already flagged between RFP-031 and RFP-033 for masonry wall embeds.

_open_pm_items.title: Alternates 022.01 and 022.02 not carried
_open_pm_items.detail: Alternate 022.01 (ADD - the narrative's own heading reads 'Track & Field Athletic Equipment' but the body text prices Scoreboards per Scope of Work #019, which appears to be a drafting error in the narrative itself - Scoreboards are Scope of Work #089) and Alternate 022.02 (ADD - Storm Drainage System per Civil drawings, which CG&B priced as a $126,000 field-drainage alternate excluding the ACO trench drain and south SDMH/RCP outfall) are both absent from the $1,139,000 carried in the GMP. Neither alternate is reflected in this exhibit's Subcontract Amount.
